author: davidarngar
text: Claude Code exposed users' email addresses to third-party websites without their knowledge. When visiting certain sites, the agent could include a user's personal email address in the HTTP User-Agent header, potentially triggering dozens of scam emails per day.

author: bsormagec
text: Your coding agent has been handing out your email address to every website it visits. Claude Code put users' account email in the User-Agent header of web requests it composed. The reporter who filed the bug now gets dozens of scam emails a day.

author: SGImike
text: BREAKING: Claude Code leaked your email to sites it visited. GitHub #107757 hit #1 on HN. Users got dozens of scam emails/day. Fix: Update to 2.1.317+; /plugins → privacy mod ON. Agents that browse for you also leak for you.

author: Pick_Analytica
text: The Hacker News: SSHole is already being exploited. Previdian got root on an Alpine OpenSSH honeypot less than 9 hours after the CVE. Eight attempts came from one Japan IP. Update to OpenSSH 10.6p2 and restart sshd if you run musl without PAM.

author: jeromerousselot
text: sshole critical ssh vulnerability on Alpine Linux, OpenWRT Linux and all other Linux systems using musl library instead of glibc. Anyone can get a remote ssh user shell by entering a random password longer than 256 characters. https://sshhole.com/

author: FOSSForce
text: Here we go again: Meet *sshole, the vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices

author: SinghalPratul
text: A long password can break into Alpine servers. sshole: CVE-2026-123158, rated 8.1. Any password 257 to 1024 chars gets in. Accounts meant for keys only are the target. Fix is out in OpenSSH 10.6p2, patch now.

author: MarwanMoftah
text: XSA-523 (CVE-2026-102703/102704): Xen grant-copy bugs let a guest read/write other guests and Dom0. Who: Xen 4.6+, XCP-ng, Qubes. Fix: upstream 4.17+ patches (Nov 3); reboot Dom0. Can't patch: no known mitigation. Exploited: none public. Discovered by Anthropic.

author: amartya_jha_
text: Claude wasn't alone on the CVE credit. Xen also credited our team at @CodeAntAI for independently finding this 11-year-old bug and building a working guest-to-dom0 exploit. Blog: Xenbleed grant-copy cache bug (CVE-2026-102704).

author: TheHackerWire
text: Critical Pre-Auth RCE in Apache OFBiz (CVE-2026-83542, CVSS 9.8). Multipart upload stages widget XML & overrides mainDecoratorLocation to run unsandboxed Groovy code without auth. Action: Upgrade to 24.09.08.

author: SecAlertsCo
text: Apache OFBiz CVE-2026-83542: unauthenticated RCE via login-page widget injection, CVSS 9.8. A public PoC is already out. Versions before 24.09.08 are exposed. Patch now.

author: Abbas_Mistrah
text: Your MCP debugger is attack surface. Pillar found RCE in MCP Inspector: on Windows/WSL a remote server's OAuth URL hit PowerShell during login (CVE-2026-119025, 8.8). The tool built to vet hostile servers trusted one. Upgrade to 2.12.0+.

author: TrustMountAI
text: The tool meant to vet untrusted MCP servers got RCE'd. Pillar Security (5 Nov): high-severity RCE in the official MCP Inspector on Windows/WSL — during remote MCP OAuth, no extra consent. CVE-2026-119025.

author: Levitt_Matt
text: Chainalysis Breach Exposes All Users' Credentials, Forces Shutdown of Key Services

author: 2Workly
text: Attackers exploit LiteLLM flaw CVE-2026-40217 to escalate API keys and resell enterprise access via Jet Night. Mandiant reports losses over $1M. Audit model gateways and enforce rate limits.

author: ThreatIntelDgst
text: UPDATE: Mandiant says attackers exploited LiteLLM CVE-2026-40217 in one LLMjacking intrusion to upgrade ordinary keys to admin credentials, adding a new route from stolen cloud access to control of AI accounts.

author: networkCPU
text: Cisco disclosed Nov. 4: a high-severity UCS Central RCE (CVSS 7.6) plus medium-impact flaws in UCM and ISE. No workarounds exist—inventory affected deployments and prioritize fixed releases.

author: CloudDoctrineHQ
text: Cisco confirms two critical PHP RCE flaws (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619), tracked as PHP2shell, affect Expressway, URWB and Duo Access Gateway. Patches available. Check the Cisco advisory and upgrade now. Source: Cisco Security Advisory, Nov 6, 2026.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-83844: Microsoft Paint RCE Fix Now Available — Why Windows Update Won't Deliver It. In late 2026, Microsoft addressed a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Windows Paint.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: High · Patched. Microsoft Paint RCE CVE-2026-83844 fixed in Store build 11.2609.401.0 (not via Windows Update).

author: Pirat_Nation
text: Microsoft Paint has a security vulnerability that could let hackers run malicious code on your PC over a network. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-83844, is rated 8.1 (High) and could allow attackers to execute code over a network without permission.

author: PacketReport1
text: Zyxel GS1900 switches: Patch 2 didn't close the hole. Binarly says the same exploit still works; Zyxel's new CVE-2026-107441 fix is 2.90 Patch 3 (10 models). Check: what firmware is your GS1900 on, and is its web UI off the open network?

author: CveTodo
text: Zyxel has released firmware updates to close a zero-day vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-107441, that a suspected Chinese-speaking threat actor exploited to breach nearly 1,000 GS1900 series network switches.

author: CloneSystemsInc
text: CVE-2026-111357: Ivanti Connect Secure is on CISA's exploited list. The missing authentication flaw lets a local authenticated user escalate privileges. Patch now, then run a scan.

author: junli_sec8
text: Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-111357 (KEV) chains with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527. Takeaway: patching an edge VPN box closes the hole; it doesn't tell you what ran before.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Barracuda ESG: researchers demonstrate a pre-auth root execution chain when the admin interface is reachable. CVE-2026-116606 + CVE-2026-111560: restrict admin access and verify vendor patches. No in-the-wild exploitation confirmed.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Attackers can chain CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 to reach root on Barracuda ESG with zero credentials — no login, no admin account, just a forged backup and a hardcoded secret buried in the firmware.

author: xingyuwang
text: 948 Linux flaws are not 948 completed fixes. Review, backports, releases and deployment still take work. I mapped that chain and examined what the evidence says about maintainer capacity. Pressure is real; collapse is not established.

author: TeresaButlsr
text: AI is becoming a powerful cybersecurity weapon on both sides. OpenAI reportedly developed a security model that identified 948 Linux kernel exploits. AI could transform vulnerability research, but it also raises serious questions about cyber risks.

author: RaviReddy1947
text: OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber found 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities. Its exploit benchmark score jumped from 32.1% to 48.5%. The bigger question: Can defenders patch vulnerabilities as quickly as AI discovers them?

author: MeghUpdates
text: BIG CYBERSECURITY ALERT. China-linked AI tools are being flagged in a sophisticated hacking campaign targeting India's financial sector. CERT-In has identified four AI-powered hacking tools reportedly linked to Chinese cyber operations.

author: a16z
text: AI can now help turn a published fix into a working exploit in hours. Patching still takes weeks, and for many old routers, cameras, and supermarket fridges, a fix never arrives.

author: rajamanjunathan
text: Bun's creator just said "Dependencies are over" after one Brotli bug hit .NET, Node, Bun, and Envoy at the same time. The hard part wasn't the patch. It was that almost nobody had put Brotli on their risk list. CVE-2026-111497.

author: wirelesslyhere
text: Self-hosted Metabase: Singapore's CSA says CVE-2026-72898 (CVSS 10.0) is being exploited. Pre-auth SQLi on /api/session/reset_password can plant an admin session. Patch now (0.58.24 / 0.59.21 / 0.60.17 / 0.61.11 / 0.62.9 / 0.63.5+), revoke sessions, rotate DB creds.

author: EvelynOnSec
text: CISA added WordPress Core RCE flaw CVE-2026-119977 to KEV—patch now before peripheral blogs become corporate backdoors.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-107640 (CVSS 9.1). Integrics Enswitch 3.13-4.4 auth bypass in /api/json/user/password/update/ lets attackers reset ANY password without authentication. Admin takeover risk after username enum. Patch NOW!

author: mergenewsapp
text: Critical Jenkins Remoting flaw (CVE-2026-70426) allows attackers to bypass security and run arbitrary code. Patch now.

author: iamsstef
text: iOS Security Advisory. Security researchers have identified two exploit kits targeting outdated iPhones: Coruna: iOS 13.0–17.2.1; DarkSword: iOS 18.4–18.7. These attacks exploit iOS itself, sometimes through compromised websites or ads.

author: Npj8448
text: Zero-day exploits hit Zyxel switches (CVE-2026-107441) and SonicWall GMS (CVE-2026-102255) while Lazarus Group breached Binance via a fake interview. Patch now, hunt phishing kits, watch API-key abuse.

author: Business_Real_
text: OpenAI has stopped letting its most powerful models see the internet while they train. The reason is two incidents in three months. In July during a cyber-capability test, OpenAI agents (Including GPT-5.6 Sol and an internal model) found a zero-day vulnerability.
